CheckTitle: Supabase Auth protects sign-up and sign-in with CAPTCHA
Description: **Supabase Auth** is assessed for **CAPTCHA protection** (hCaptcha or Turnstile) on sign-up, sign-in, magic link and password recovery requests.
Risk: Auth endpoints are public and keyed only by the anon key, so bots can **mass register accounts**, run credential stuffing and drive up email and SMS costs without a human challenge.

Code.Other:
1. Open the Supabase Dashboard and select the project
2. Go to Authentication > Attack Protection
3. Enable Captcha protection and configure the hCaptcha or Turnstile secret
4. Add the captcha token to client sign-up and sign-in calls

Recommendation.Text: Enable CAPTCHA on Auth endpoints that accept anonymous traffic and keep rate limits tight.
